items.s: On 30 May 2025, Swift ____ her fans that she had bought the recordings.

tfn.s: Swift bought the recordings of her first six albums.
tfn.why: The text says: "she had bought the original recordings of her first six albums"

tfn.s: Swift bought the recordings from her own family.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "She bought them from a company called Shamrock Capital."

tfn.s: Swift paid more than 100 million dollars for the recordings.
tfn.why: Not stated. The text says nobody said how much she paid.

tfn.s: Four of the albums already had new versions.
tfn.why: The text says: "Swift had already made new versions of four of those albums."

tfn.s: Swift did not thank her fans in her letter.
tfn.why: The text says the opposite: "She thanked her fans for supporting her new versions and her tour."
